purchase:
    'kingdoms_kingdom_level < 3': '{$$kingdom-levels.III}'
  upgrade:
    'level == 1 && kingdoms_kingdom_level < 4': '{$$kingdom-levels.IV}'
    'level == 2 && kingdoms_kingdom_level < 5': '{$$kingdom-levels.V}'

# Below values are added to the main value.

    name: "&a{$$words.tier} I"
    shield-damage: 2min
    explosion-radius: 1
    damage: 1
    knockback: 1
    building-impact:
      damage: 30
    item:
      material: IRON_BLOCK
  mid-tier:
    name: "&3{$$words.tier} II"

    explosion-radius: 1
    damage: 2
    knockback: 2
    building-impact:
      damage: 50
      paralyze: 5s
    item:
      material: GOLD_BLOCK
  high-tier:
    name: "&c{$$words.tier} III"
    shield-damage: 5min
    explosion-radius: 2
    damage: 3
    knockback: 3
    building-impact:
      damage: 70
      paralyze: 10s
    item:
      material: FIRE_CHARGE

      it will destroy the blocks.

      depending on the item used as ammo.
